bandReport.notes:
Band bA = Q1-Q40 across p00 (Q1-10), p01 (Q11-20), p02 (Q21-30), p03 (Q31-40) — a uniform 10 questions per page, 5 per column. Layout is two-column: read the LEFT column top-to-bottom (odd half) then the RIGHT column; numbering runs down the left column first (e.g. p00 left = Q1-6, right = Q7-10).

SEAM (start): Q1 is the first question of the paper, so nothing precedes it. p00 carries no header, no Directions block and no instruction preamble above Q1 — it opens directly on '1. What is the ratio of interior angle...'.

SEAM (end): Q40 is COMPLETE on p03 — its stem and all four options print there. I opened p04 (band bB's territory) WITHOUT transcribing it and confirmed the seam is clean: p04 opens at Q41 (left column) and Q43 (right column), each a self-contained 'Consider a question and two statements :' item with its own Question/Statement-I/Statement-II and its own four options. Nothing on p04 continues from p03, and nothing on p03 continues onto p04.

DIRECTIONS SETS: there are NONE anywhere in p00-p03. Every one of Q1-Q40 is a standalone MCQ with no shared stimulus, so this band opens no set and inherits none. NOTE for band bB: the Q41-Q44 block on p04 is NOT a Directions set either — each item repeats the whole 'Consider a question and two statements' frame and its own statements, so they carry no shared context and should NOT be given a setLabel. No question in this band carries `context`.

FIGURES: none. No question in Q1-Q40 prints or refers to a diagram — Q12 (perpendicular to the hypotenuse), Q18 (three touching circles) and Q39 (right triangle) are all stated fully in words with no figure on the page, so `hasFigure` is unset throughout.

DECIMALS: the booklet prints a raised middle dot (U+00B7) as the decimal separator, and Q6 is the only place it occurs in this band. Verified at 8x against the source PDF: the numerator prints five-dot-four cubed minus zero-dot-zero-six-four, and the denominator five-dot-four squared plus two-dot-one-six plus zero-dot-one-six. Every one of those dots is a SEPARATOR, not multiplication, so per the brief the values are transcribed with full stops as 5.4, 0.064, 2.16 and 0.16. (The literal glyph is deliberately not reproduced anywhere in this file, notes included, since it is on the checker's banned list.)

CURRENCY: Q32, Q33 and Q37 print the rupee glyph. Written as 'Rs.' per the brief and matching the convention already used across the 2020-1 / 2020-2 / 2023-1 bands in this pipeline.

GLYPHS VERIFIED AT 7-12x against the source PDF (nothing guessed): Q2 exponents 41^43 + 43^43; Q4 exponents 4^61 + 4^62 + 4^63 + 4^64; Q6 the decimals above; Q8 all five denominators (5v4+4v5, 6v5+5v6, 7v6+6v7, 8v7+7v8, 9v8+8v9); Q11 the whole three-term trig expression including tan 20/40/45/50/70; Q14 the four-level continued fraction (written with \cfrac per the brief); Q18 all four options; Q22 the exponents 2^(2n+2) and 2^(4n); Q24 the telescoping sum and its 2020/2021 tail; Q36 the coefficient '161x' (checked digit-by-digit against the neighbouring '16' — it is one-six-one, not a lowercase l); Q38 all four option expressions including (d) ab^2 = (c+1)^2; Q39 the sides 6x^2 and (2x^2 - 1).

MISPRINTS: none found. Every question in Q1-Q40 reads cleanly and no printed defect was flagged.

UNREADABLE: nothing. All 40 questions and all 160 options were legible.

SUBTOPICS / CATALOG (per the brief these are a work list for the extension pass, not failures). Every chapter and subtopic used in this band is valid against the catalog AS IT STANDS NOW: 0 hard failures, 0 soft warnings. One item changed status mid-run: Q37 ('Quadratic Equations' / 'Word Problems and Applications') was outside the catalog when transcribed — the item reduces to a quadratic in the cloth length, but that chapter had no word-problem subtopic and the only such entry sat under 'Linear Equations', which would have been the wrong chapter. The catalog was extended while this band was being written and now lists it, so the pair is valid; the per-question flag is kept purely as a record of the reasoning. Two further items are filed on the closest available catalog subtopic and carry a flag explaining the stretch, rather than being forced into a better-sounding but wrong fit — these are still genuine catalog gaps: Q16 asks for a perfect FOURTH power and is filed on 'Perfect Squares and Cubes' (a 'Perfect Powers' subtopic would fit better), and Q29 is pure time-unit conversion (weeks and days to minutes) for which no chapter in the catalog is a natural home, filed on 'Surds, Indices and Simplification' / 'Simplification of Expressions'.

TOOLING CONFLICT, reported rather than resolved silently: this band was told to write `2022-1.bA.json`, but check-bands.ts matches band files with the regex `^<paperId>\.b\d+\.json$` — DIGITS only — so a letter-suffixed band is invisible to it and `npx tsx scripts/cds-maths/check-bands.ts 2022-1` throws 'no band files matching'. The filename in the instruction was followed. To verify, this file was driven through the REAL exported `checkBand` function (imported from check-bands.ts, not re-implemented) and reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Either the regex needs widening to `b[0-9A-Za-z]+` or the letter bands need renaming before the merge step.

questions.stem:
What is the value of the following?

\(\frac{(5.4)^3 - 0.064}{(5.4)^2 + 2.16 + 0.16}\)

What is the value of the following?

\(\frac{1}{5\sqrt{4} + 4\sqrt{5}} + \frac{1}{6\sqrt{5} + 5\sqrt{6}} + \frac{1}{7\sqrt{6} + 6\sqrt{7}} + \frac{1}{8\sqrt{7} + 7\sqrt{8}} + \frac{1}{9\sqrt{8} + 8\sqrt{9}}\)

If \(x = 9999\), then what is the value of the following?

\(\frac{4x^3 - x}{(2x + 1)(6x - 3)}\)
If \((x + \sqrt{1 + x^2})(y + \sqrt{1 + y^2}) = 1\), where \(x\) and \(y\) are real numbers, then what is the value of \((x + y)^2\) ?

What is the value of the following?

\(\frac{2\sin 68^\circ}{\cos 22^\circ} - \frac{2\cot 15^\circ}{5\tan 75^\circ} - \frac{3\tan 20^\circ \tan 40^\circ \tan 45^\circ \tan 50^\circ \tan 70^\circ}{5}\)

The perpendicular dropped from a vertex of a right-angled triangle upon the hypotenuse divides it into two segments of lengths 9 units and 16 units respectively. What is the length of the perpendicular?

If \(43^x \times 47^y = (2021)^2\), \(x \ne 0\), \(y \ne 0\), then what is the value of the following?

\(\frac{4xy + x + y}{2xy - x - y}\)

Let \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(d\) be positive integers. If

\(\cfrac{1}{a + \cfrac{1}{b + \cfrac{1}{c + \cfrac{1}{d}}}} = \frac{17}{60}\)

then what is the product of \(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(d\) ?
If \(x^2 = 17x + y\) and \(y^2 = x + 17y\), \(x \ne y\), then what is the value of \(\sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + 1}\) ?
What is the least value of \(n\) if \(194480 + n = m^4\), where \(m\) and \(n\) are natural numbers?
flags: Subtopic is a stretch: the catalog's nearest entry is 'Perfect Squares and Cubes' but this item asks for a perfect FOURTH power. Kept the catalog entry rather than forcing a worse chapter; a 'Perfect Powers' subtopic would fit better.
